rule: A case is `train` when the first byte of sha256("<seed>:<case directory name>") is below 154 (about 60%), else `test`. The rule depends on the case's name alone, so adding a case never moves another.
seed_note: Drawn at random from 32 bits. The first draw put 11 of 14 cases in train, so seeds were redrawn (1 draws in all) until train held 8 or 9 of the 14; the redraw looked at case counts only, before any case had been run.
